findings.evidence: GeneratingFunction.lean:44-54: hasFDerivAt_stripGeneratingFunction requires F to be C² on the segment and Y(x, 0) = 0. exists_stripShear_comp_twist_factorization only gives MapsTo of the strip and first-derivative inequalities.
findings.fix: Say that, under the additional C² and boundary-preservation hypotheses of GeneratingFunction.lean, each factor admits a generating function. Or state it as the intended downstream use rather than as a fact about these factors.
findings.issue: Overclaim: 'Each such factor is a twist map of the strip, generated by a function S(x, X) (TauCeti.stripGeneratingFunction)'. The factors here are only shown to have C¹ derivative bounds and to map the strip into itself; nothing establishes that they are C² or that they fix the boundary line y = 0.

findings.evidence: The hypothesis hdet : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 1, ∀ q ∈ univ ×ˢ I, (fderiv ℝ (k t) q).det = 1 is unconditional in the theorem, and hinv is built from it.
findings.fix: State that the factorization is proved for area-preserving families (hdet), and that the factors then preserve area, map the strip into itself and commute with the deck translation.
findings.issue: 'When every k_t preserves area and maps the strip into itself, so does every factor' suggests the factorization holds without area preservation. In fact exists_stripShear_comp_twist_factorization always assumes hdet and uses it to derive invertibility of the derivatives.

summary: The module docstring of TwistFactorization.lean promises that each factor has a generating function, which needs C² and boundary-preservation hypotheses this file does not establish. It also presents area preservation as optional when the main theorem always assumes it.
